Under the SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, the guidelines do not impose a minimum net‑worth requirement on individual investment advisers. The only financial condition that is specified is a deposit that an adviser must maintain, which is determined by the maximum number of clients the adviser has on any day of the previous financial year. The deposit schedule is:
- Up to 150 clients – ₹1 lakh
- 151–300 clients – ₹2 lakh
- 301–1,000 clients – ₹5 lakhs
- 1,001 and above – ₹10 lakhs [1] [2]
